title: Integrations
hooks.title: Incoming hooks
hooks.explain: A hook is a private address and a token that do one thing: redeploy one project. Give it to a CI tool that should not hold a full key. It acts as you, and stops working if you lose the right to deploy.
hooks.name: Name
hooks.once: Copy the token now: it is shown only once.
metrics.title: Metrics for Prometheus
metrics.explain: Create an API key with the right to read metrics and give it to Prometheus. It sees only the machines you can see.
